newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude Medical Q3 below EPS consensus.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude Medical Q3 below EPS consensus.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc said earnings for the third quarter rose 4.7 percent over year-ago levels to $0.44 per share, just shy of the First Call consensus forecast of $0.45 per share.
"It was not a strong quarter," said J.P. Morgan medical technology analyst Michael Weinstein. "It was a penny under consensus and the heart valve business showed no growth."
St. Jude is the world's largest maker of heart valves and a major manufacturer of pacemakers and other medical devices.
Profits were hurt by changed U.S. regulations concerning Puerto Rican-related tax benefits, St. Jude said.
